description:
The Uniform Years is about the men and women who wore the uniform in the 1960s and 1970s — firefighters, cops, sailors and soldiers — and the everyday world they lived in.

Firehouse kitchens and brass poles. Beat cops and call boxes. Boot camp, barracks and the ships. The unwritten rules nobody put on paper, and the things that are gone forever.

We dig through archives, old rulebooks and first-hand accounts to show how it really was — the good, the tough and the dangerous.

If you served, grew up in a firehouse or police family, or just remember the era — you're in the right place. Share your memories in the comments: your stories are the real history here.

New stories every Tuesday and Friday.
